ሰብእ: ሰብእ — man, human being, people (noun) · 'humankind' (መፍቀሬ ሰብእ 'lover of humankind')

ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
ብዙኀ: ብዙኅ — many, much (adjective, masc. sg., accusative)
ንጹሐ: ንጹሕ — clean, pure, innocent (adjective; accusative form)
ወወለደ: ወለደ — and he begot (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-l-d)
ወከሠተ: ከሠተ — and he opened, uncovered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, k-ś-t)

ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?) · 'in the place of, as in' before a construct noun (ኀበ ነገረ ኢሳይያስ 'as in the word of Isaiah')
ነሥአ: ነሥአ — he took (3ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of') · from where (እምኀበ ኢሀሎ 'from where there was not', before a clause)
ወረደ: ወረደ — he went down, descended (3ms perfect, G, w-r-d) · ወ is part of the root, not 'and'
ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?) · accusative 'a voice' (ቃለ ሠናየ 'a good voice') · 'sound of' (construct: ቃለ ቀርን 'sound of the horn')
ወበትረ: በትር — and rod of (ወ- + noun, construct) · and staff (ወ- + noun, accusative; ሕልቀተ ወበትረ 'ring and staff')
በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people') · 'since' of time (ዮም ተሱዕ መዋዕል በዘ ኀለፉ 'it is nine days since they passed')
ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
ትተረጐም: ተርጐመ — she/it is interpreted (3fs imperfect, T stem passive; agrees with ባሕር)
መስቀል: መስቀል — cross (noun; genitive after the construct ዕፀ)
እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?) · 'of' before a genitive, standing for the feminine relative (ሃይማኖት እንተ አበው ሐዋርያት 'the faith of the fathers, the apostles'; ሃይማኖተ እንተ ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'the faith of the Church') · fem. relative before a verb with the object understood (ሥጋ እንተ ነሥአ 'the flesh which he took') · 'in which, through which' before በ- + suffix (እንተ ባቲ 'which in her') · 'the one' in እንተ የማኑ 'that of his right', and before a verb with suffix, 'which founded it' (እንተ ሣረረታ) · 'from' (?) before ቀላየ ባሕር, standing for a preposition because the relative 'which' fits poorly (እንተ ቀላየ ባሕር 'from the depths of the sea', Psalm 68:22) (?)

ወዐርገ: ዐርገ — and he ascended (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ʿ-r-g)
ሰማያተ: ሰማይ — heavens (plural ሰማያት, accusative; ዐርገ ሰማያተ 'he ascended the heavens')
ሰ: ሰ — as for, however (enclitic contrastive particle, detached by a stray wordspace from ወለአይሁድ) (?)
ብሔረ: ብሔር — land, region (construct 'land of') · accusative 'a land' (ርሑቀ ብሔረ 'far, a land'; the construct reading is the alternative (?))

አሚነ: አሚን — faith, belief (noun, accusative; from አምነ 'believe') (?)
ወበይእቲ: ይእቲ — and through that, through her (ወ- + በ- + 3fs pronoun/demonstrative)

ንድኅን: ድኅነ — we may be saved (1cp subjunctive, G, d-ḫ-n)
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
ነበበ: ነበበ — he spoke (3ms perfect, G, n-b-b)
አፉሁ: አፍ — his mouth (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; the stem is አፉ- before the suffix)

ጥዩቀ: ጥዩቅ — certain, exact; 'certainly' (adjective, accusative/adverbial form in -a)
ኢኮንኩ: ኮነ — I am not, was not (ኢ- 'not' + 1cs perfect, G, k-w-n)

ወተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — and he arose (ወ- + 3ms perfect, Gt)

ለነ: ለ — to us, for us (ለ- + 1cp suffix -ነ) · 'over us' (ንገሢ ለነ 'reign over us')
ለእለ: እለ — those who, who (plural relative pronoun; ለ- 'to, for') · ለ- naming the owner after an anticipating suffix (አዝማዲሆሙ ለእለ ኀልቁ 'the kinsmen of those who perished')
አመነ: አምነ — he believed (3ms perfect of አምነ 'believe, have faith', with በ- 'in'; after plural እለ, an irregular match: distributive, or slip for አመኑ (?))
በእደ: እድ — by the hand of (በ- + noun, construct; plural stem አእዳው)
አኀዊሁ: አኅ — his brothers (noun, plural አኀው + -ሁ '3ms his')
ይሁዳ: ይሁዳ — Judah (proper name) · Judas, the betrayer (በእንተ ይሁዳ ድልው ሊተ ዐስብየ 'concerning Judas, my wage is ready'; heading of ch. 108)
ወበኀበ: ኀበ — and before, with (ወ- + በ- + ኀበ) · and among (ወበኀበ አብዳንሰ 'and among fools') · and at the place where (ወበኀበ ኀደሩሰ 'and where they dwelt'; ch. 53)
አድኀኖሙ: አድኀነ — he saved them (3ms perfect, causative of ድኅነ + -ሙ '3mp them')
ለአኀዊሁ: እኁ — to his brothers (ለ- + plural አኀው, stem አኀዊ- + -ሁ '3ms his')
አድኀነነ: አድኀነ — he saved us (3ms perfect, causative of ድኅነ, + -ነ 'us', 1cp)
ወረሰየነ: ረሰየ — and he made us, set us as (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, r-s-y + -ነ '1cp us')
መዋርስቲሁ: ዋርስ — his heirs (noun; plural-form መዋርስት + -ሁ '3ms his', root w-r-s 'inherit'; singular and pattern uncertain, ዋርስ is a guess (?))
ለአዝማዲሁ: አዝማድ — to his kin (ለ- + አዝማድ, plural of ዘመድ 'kin' + -ሁ '3ms his')
በምድረ: ምድር — in the land of (በ- + noun, construct)
ከማሁ: ከማሁ — likewise, like him (ከመ + -hu) · 'thus, so' answering ከመ (ከማሁ ታንጐደጒድ 'so it thunders')
ይሁቦሙ: ወሀበ — he gives them (3ms imperfect ይሁብ + -ሙ '3mp them')
ማኅደረ: ማኅደር — dwelling-place (construct) · accusative 'a lodging' (ወወሀባ ማኅደረ 'and he gave her a lodging')
ዘለዓለም: ለዓለም — everlasting, eternal (ዘ- 'of' + ለዓለም 'for ever'; ክብረ ዘለዓለም 'glory of eternity') · 'for ever' as an adverb after a noun (ደዌ ዘለዓለም 'sickness for ever')
ሙታን: ምውት — the dead (plural ሙታን of ምውት 'dead'; እምነ ሙታን 'from among the dead')
ትእምርተ: ትእምርት — sign, token (noun, fem., accusative) · construct 'sign of' (ትእምርተ ሕይወት 'sign of life')
ታእምር: አእመረ — that you may know (2ms subjunctive)
ነገሩ: ነገር — his speech, word, matter (noun + -ሁ '3ms his') · they spoke, 'were said', impersonal 3mp perfect (ነኪር ነገሩ በእንቲአኪ 'wondrous things were said about you', Psalm 87:3 as quoted, ch. 98) (?)
ቦአ: ቦአ — he entered (3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
ተሣይጦ: ተሣየጠ — to buy, buying (verbal noun of ተሣየጠ, 'buy from')
ወውሉዲ: ውሉድ — and his children (?) (ወ- 'and' + noun, plural + -ሁ '3ms his'; the printed ውሉዲ for ውሉዱ) (?)
ወብእሲቱ: ብእሲት — and his wife (ወ- + noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his')
ለሳራ: ሳራ — Sarah (ለ- marking the object + proper name)
ብእሲቱ: ብእሲት — his wife (noun + -u 'his') · 'his wife' with the owner added after it (ብእሲቱ እኁሁ 'his wife, his brother's'; not the construct ብእሲተ)
ለሊሁ: ለሊሁ — he himself, his very self
ተቀብረ: ቀበረ — he/it was buried (3ms perfect, Gt passive, q-b-r)
በህየ: ህየ — there, in that place (በ- + adverb)
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
ይትነሣእ: ተንሥአ — let him arise (3ms jussive, Gt, n-ś-ʾ)
ቱ: እሙንቱ — (?) final syllable of እሙንቱ 'they are' split off by the wordspace, so እሙን ቱ ≈ 'they are' (?); not a separate word · in ch. 111 (መኑ ውእ ቱ ዝንቱ) the end of ውእቱ 'he, it is', split off by the printed wordspace (ውእ ፡ ቱ); not a word of its own
ግብጽ: ግብጽ — Egypt (proper name; genitive after construct) · Egypt as goal of a journey, accusative without a preposition (ርደተ አብርሃም ግብጽ 'descent of Abraham to Egypt') · the Egyptians (ርእይዎሙ ግብጽ 'the Egyptians saw them')
ነፍስ: ነፍስ — soul, person, life (noun) · 'living, alive' as predicate (እንዘ ነፍስ ኮነት 'while living it became'; ዘነፍስ 'that of life')
ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
በዝኀ: በዝኀ — it multiplied, increased (3ms perfect, G, b-z-ḫ)
ለፀብእ: ፀብእ — war, battle (noun; ለ- 'for, to': ተንሥኡ ለፀብእ 'they set out for war')
ወሞተ: ሞተ — and he died (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, m-w-t)
ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
ለዮሴፍ: ዮሴፍ — to Joseph (proper name; ለ- 'to, for')
አምሕሎ: አምሕሎ — oath (verbal noun of አምሐለ, used as a cognate accusative)
ይኩን: ኮነ — let him be (3m sg jussive, k-w-n) · let it be (3ms jussive, here after ዘእንበለ 'except': ዘእንበለ ይኩን ቆዐ ሠርጸ ጽጌ 'except it be that the tendril put forth blossom') (?)
ለእስራኤል: እስራኤል — to Israel, O Israel (ለ- + proper name) · over Israel (ይነግሥ ለእስራኤል 'he shall reign over Israel') · marking the object after ወአኅለፎሙ 'and he made them pass, Israel' · ለ- marking the possessor after a noun (እከዮሙ ለእስራኤል 'their evil, (that) of Israel') · 'for Israel' (ሥርዐቱ ለእስራኤል 'his ordinance for Israel')
ሐመ: ሐመ — he was ill (3ms perfect, G, ḥ-m-m) · 'he suffered' (ሐመ ሕማም 'he suffered a suffering')
ጸውዖሙ: ጸውዐ — he called them (3ms perfect, G, ṣ-w-ʿ, + -ሙ '3mp them')
ወለደቂቁ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (ወ- 'and' + ለ- 'to' marking the object + plural ደቂቅ + -ሁ 'his', 3ms)
ወአምሐሎሙ: አምሐለ — and he made them swear, adjured them (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, causative አ- stem of መሐለ, m-ḥ-l; + -ሙ 'them', joined by -o-)
አዕፅምትየ: ዐፅም — my bones (noun, plural አዕፅምት + -የ '1cs my')
